decided_by: PI, 2026-09-29: audit later collections on the code the collector actually executes
rule: a later collection is equivalent to the reference iff every closure file is identical, or its exact (blob_a, blob_b) change is listed here; any other edit -- or a later edit of a listed file -- breaks it

reviewed_changes.review: new module: provenance helpers (scientific tree hash, dirty check, commit/closure identity). Imported by the collector only inside _git_identity; computes hashes of the repository, never touches the env.

_git_identity now records scientific_tree_sha256 and treats any uncommitted scientific path (not only experiments/) as dirty; the refusal message names those paths. Provenance and launch guard only: no change to episodes, acting, allocator, KL targets, stored keys, shard format or fingerprint fields other than what the manifest records about its own code.

review_basis: git diff 342cbc46..<reviewed_at_commit> of both files, read in full on 2026-09-29
